arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle to your own steady pace.

text: let_go: holding the pack takes about 235 W shaft, 40 W over sustainable, reserve would empty within about 1.3 km of 9.8 km.

arguments.message: pod reserve runs out well before the finish at this shaft power

text: no cue: shaft power already eased to 200 W, near sustainable 195 W; pod reserve 83 percent; over-pace alert came from the boat model, replaced with a pod-based watch.

arguments.text: Stay on their wash at this effort, smooth and relaxed.

arguments.message: pod reserve empties well before the finish at this shaft power

text: hang_on: on the wash the pack speed costs 202 W shaft, only 7 W over sustainable, worth far more than solo pace.

arguments.text: Close the gap after the turn, sit right on their wash.

text: hang_on: wash benefit shrinking (local push 0.32 vs 0.21 along) at a near-sustainable 199 W; keep the cheap wash.

arguments.text: Ease a touch, just under this effort, long and steady.

text: ease: 200 W shaft is 6 W over sustainable with little wash benefit left; pod reserve would empty 4.4 km before the finish.
no cue: new leg only; shaft 198 W close to sustainable 194 W, pod reserve 59 percent, speed steady.

arguments.reason: boat-model power held 155-160 W for 10 min with boat reserve empty and no fade, while pod shows 197-200 W shaft near its CP; boat CP 118 W is too low, about 0.79 of shaft CP

text: no cue: shaft 197 W near sustainable 194 W, pod reserve 50 percent, speed holding; corrected the low boat-model critical power.

arguments.text: Ease off a little more, lighter pull, keep the rate.

text: ease: 201 W shaft vs 194 W sustainable, pod reserve 45 percent empties about 4 km before the finish.

arguments.text: Settle to 2:36 pace into this current, save energy.

text: ease to 2:36: 202 W shaft vs 193 W sustainable, pod reserve 33 percent would empty with 4.7 km still to go.
no cue: new leg; shaft 195 W close to sustainable 192 W, pod reserve 27 percent, pacing about right.

arguments.text: Lift the effort a touch, firm steady pull.

text: push: shaft drifted down to 184 W, below 192 W sustainable with pod reserve 27 percent; fade jump is mostly the turn and lower power.
no cue: new leg; shaft 191 W matches 192 W sustainable, pod reserve 25 percent, steady.

arguments.message: deep fade: speed at this rate well below early race

text: no cue: fade steady near -4.5 percent, not worsening, partly early wash baseline and the turn; shaft 194 W at sustainable.

arguments.text: Lengthen out, drop the rate two, same effort.

text: rate_down: fade has worsened to about -7 percent and lasts, more than the small power drop explains; rate 62 likely now too high.

arguments.text: Longer strokes, rate down two, keep the pressure.

text: no cue: a cue went out 21 s ago; let it take effect before judging the lasting -6.6 percent fade.

arguments.text: Three k to go, lift the effort a touch now.

text: push: shaft 187 W is 7 W under the 194 W sustainable for the last 3 km, pod reserve flat at 21 percent.

arguments.text: Drop the rate two, longer reach, same pressure.

text: rate_down: fade deepened to -7.9 percent at steady 188 W and rate 62; a tiring paddler needs a lower rate.
no cue: new leg, 2 km left; shaft 191 W near sustainable, save the pod reserve for the finish sprint.

arguments.text: Lift now, build the effort toward the finish.

text: push: shaft fell to 181 W, well under the 200 W sustainable, with 22 percent pod reserve and 1.3 km left.

arguments.text: One k left, more pressure now, hold it to the sprint.

text: push: 1 km left at 186 W, 18 W under the 204 W sustainable, pod reserve 24 percent unspent.

arguments.text: Five hundred to go, sprint home now, empty the tank.

text: finish: 548 m left with 22 percent pod reserve unspent; enough for a sprint of about 3 minutes to the line.
